subject: Warning message: Missing value for survey covariate (p.effort) for non-missing detection data

messages.author: 8cf3e797273801fc
messages.subject: Warning message: Missing value for survey covariate (p.effort) for non-missing detection data
parts:
Hello,

I'm doing an occupancy analysis for the first time and I'm struggling with a warning message that I get when I try to run a single-season model to test the effect of effort.

This happens using the occMod function of the RPresence package. So I'm not sure if I'm asking my question in the right group (I couldn't find a group for RPresence), but as I assume it's also related to the detectionHistory function in the camtrapR package,  I thought I'd give it a chance here.

So first I created the detection history matrix as follows:

detect_hist_all <- detectionHistory(recordTable = occupancy,
                                    species = "éléphant",
                                    camOp = camop_all,
                                    stationCol = "ID_CT",
                                    speciesCol = "Species_1",
                                    recordDateTimeCol = "DateTime",
                                    recordDateTimeFormat ="Ymd HMS",
                                    occasionLength = 9,
                                    day1 = "station",
                                    timeZone = "UTC",
                                    datesAsOccasionNames = FALSE,
                                    includeEffort = T,
                                    scaleEffort = T)


Then, I transformed it to a dataframe and added two columns ‘AAC’ and ‘Year’ which are 2 variables I want to test:

dethistories_all$ID_CT <- rownames(dethistories_all)

dethistories_all <- merge(dethistories_all, infocam_all, by = "ID_CT")

AAC=dethistories_all$AAC

Year =dethistories_all$Year

I also had to transform the effort variable to use it when creating the PAO:

effort <- as.data.frame(detect_hist_all$effort)

effort<-mapply(as.numeric,effort) 

effort=as.vector(effort)


Then I created the Pao that will be used in the different models:

PAO_all=createPao(data=dethistories_all[,c(2:(ncol(dethistories_all)-9))],

                  unitcov = data.frame(AAC=AAC,Year=Year),

                  survcov = data.frame(effort=effort))


Then I ran several single-season models and the warning message appeared in all models testing ‘effort’, for example :

psi_Year_p_effort_all=occMod(model=list(psi~Year,p~effort),data=PAO_all,type="so")

Warning message:

In runPresence(temp.pao, list(psi.dm, p.dm, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL),  :

Missing value for survey covariate (p.effort) for non-missing detection data


Not all cameras have been running for the same number of days, so the NAs correspond to the last few occasions (during which some cameras were already no longer working).

Any idea

1) if this warning message is really a problem (as the model still runs and it is normal to have missing values there since the cameras were not working anymore)?

2) of what I should do to solve this problem, if it is really a problem?

Thank you,
Morgane

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: [camtrapR] Warning message: Missing value for survey covariate (p.effort) for non-missing detection data
parts:
Hello,
I am afraid I can't help in with this issue since I haven't used RPresence before.

Personally I prefer the package unmarked and its Bayesian sibling ubms for occupancy models. The data format which detectionHistory provides is also made to be compatible with those packages.

The warning sounds like some values in the detection matrix had NA effort. If that is the case directly in the output of detectionHistory it would be a bug, otherwise maybe a data manipulation mistake?
In any case the model output is likely wrong if detections and effort are disconnected.

Directly contacting the maintainer of RPresence would also be an option if you really need to use that package and it's not a data manipulation issue.

Best regards,
Jürgen

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: [camtrapR] Warning message: Missing value for survey covariate (p.effort) for non-missing detection data
parts:
I believe there may be a misunderstanding. The way I read the warning (which might be wrong though) is that there are detection information (0 or 1) which have a corresponding effort of NA. That should never happen in the output of detextionHistory(), and therefore also not in the data you derived from it. So my point is not about NAs in the detection and effort matrices, but a mismatch of the pattern of NAs between the two.

It could be either a bug in detectionHistory, or (more likely) a mistake in data manipulation in your code.

So please check if the pattern of NAs in the output of detectionHistory is identical between the detection and effort matrices. 

If yes then please carefully check your data wrangling steps, some of which look dodgy, e.g. this part:
c(2:(ncol(dethistories_all)-9)) 

Only the I'd suggest to contact the maintainer of the package.

In general, NAs in the camera operation matrix and detection history and effort matrix are normal and nothing to worry about (at least in unmarked and ubms, don't know about RPresence). Replacing them with 0 is a bad idea since that leads to detection probabilities greater than 0 in those occasions and biases model estimates. 
Best,
J

OK, thanks Jürgen for the clarification.
I've found the source of the error. The detectionHistory output was correct for both dethistories and efforts.
But later, when I merged the dethistories with another data frame, the order of the rows changed, so that the NAs of the dethistories no longer matched the NAs of the effort matrix.

I managed to solve this problem and now everything works fine.

Thank you very much for your help!

Best,

Morgane
